sentences.text: Maomingosuchus was a relatively small crocodile, reaching an estimated length of 3 to 3.5 meters.
The type species was originally named in 1958 but was redescribed as Maomingosuchus in 2017.
A second species was described in 2022 from deposits in northern Vietnam that are dated to 39–35 million years ago.
It belongs to the family Gavialidae.
Its parent group is classified as Tomistominae.
Scientists propose it is either a basal member of Gavialoidea or belongs to the family Tomistominae.
This animal lived during the Late Eocene in Southeast Asia, between 48.07 and 33.9 million years ago.
Fossils have been found in Priabonian-aged deposits in China and possibly Thailand.
